governance_boundary.unique_direction: single request-local atomic producer of one full logical canonical target CSR and one objective
governance_boundary.tile_is_not_runtime_chunking: The width-64 factor-column tile is an internal, nonconfigurable arithmetic schedule. It has no partial publish, partial solve, transaction, retry, dynamic sizing, or runtime menu.
forbidden_closed_mechanisms: chunked solver loading or direct highspy addRows
lock, lease, handoff, or adapter transaction

symbols.n: input factors in ascending input_rows order
symbols.F: first phase preactivation coefficients in global phase-row order, shape P by n
symbols.D: sole initial phase-delta coefficients in global phase-row order, shape P by k
symbols.Fo: first output coefficients, shape o by n
symbols.Do: sole initial output-delta coefficients, shape o by k
symbols.rho_i: global phase ordinal of change i

fixed_schedule.global_phase_order: topological network layer order, then original.stream_rows position order
fixed_schedule.change_order: strictly increasing global phase ordinal, unique, and exactly the first-to-target active-set difference
fixed_schedule.triangular_guard: for every change i, stored D[rho_i, i:] must be exactly zero

objective.association_lock: Form target output rows first, then multiply by C in output-row order. Reassociation as (C@Do)@U is forbidden.

no_full_dense_materialization: U with shape k by n
G with shape P by n
Go with shape o by n

required_outputs: full logical canonical A for the unchanged repair builder
csr_and_screen_contract.canonical_layout: contiguous int32 indptr, contiguous int32 indices, contiguous float64 data; row-major; strictly increasing columns per row; no duplicate; no explicit zero
csr_and_screen_contract.screening_rule: keep exactly the rows whose stored-binary64 dyadic box maximum is strictly greater than the stored-binary64 rhs
csr_and_screen_contract.screening_oracle: Fraction.from_float over every coefficient and factor bound
csr_and_screen_contract.drop_rule: A row may be dropped only when exact dyadic row_max <= exact dyadic rhs
csr_and_screen_contract.signed_zero_rule: Both binary64 signed zeros are algebraic zero and must be absent from emitted CSR.
csr_and_screen_contract.subnormal_rule: Finite nonzero subnormals are logical coefficients and must be preserved for the existing FrozenRows tiny projection; they are not an automatic compiler failure.
csr_and_screen_contract.audit_resolution: The signed-zero/subnormal rules follow the current logical-CSR and owner semantics; NaN, infinity, overflow, duplicate, and noncanonical mappings fail closed.

resource_contract.N_definition: full_logical_nnz, never screened or loaded nnz

equivalence_and_authority.required_equivalence: fixed mapping plus exact-real F+D@U algebra and exact dyadic screening semantics
equivalence_and_authority.reason_bitwise_not_required: The fixed segmented floating-point schedule changes binary64 rounding shape; compiler, LP, and margins have candidate authority only.
bitwise_required: global phase ordinal and physical mapping
the future terminal's single stored-binary64 input identity
equivalence_and_authority.verdict_authority: none at this CPU static gate
equivalence_and_authority.future_only_terminal_authority: raw BOX plus verifier-owned zero-width outward forward plus exact stored-binary64 Fraction property lower greater than zero

unknown_on: malformed shape, dtype, order, or mapping
noncanonical CSR or Fraction screening disagreement
failure_and_cleanup_contract.owned_snapshot: Every input is copied to immutable bytes ownership before compile and bound to dtype, shape, and content SHA-256.

static_ast_and_api_forbidden: threading, asyncio, futures, queues, Lock, RLock, acquire, or release
highspy, a solver, owner, selector, terminal, or ONNX execution
labels, expected-result CSV, file, network, or environment runtime decision
chunk, partition, lease, handoff, transaction, retry, fallback, menu, or scan
second target producer or fixed-cell n-factor stream
sp.vstack, sp.hstack, sp.coo, sp.lil, sp.dok, or dense-to-CSR canonicalization
